caption: The drawing depicts a still life scene featuring a decorative white urn or vase with light blue vertical accents, positioned centrally on a brown background that appears to be a textured or damaged wall. Cracks and lines are visible, suggesting age or weathering. Emerging from the vase is a pineapple, colored in shades of orange and green, flanked by several large, pointed green leaves with lighter green highlights and white edges. A small white flower with a yellow center is also present among the leaves on the right side. The base of the vase is situated on a ledge or shelf with blue-gray and brown horizontal stripes. The artist's signature “Ruth Bowker” appears in red-brown text at the lower right corner of the image.
title: Wall Painting, Pineapple
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
